Data/Database.swift: Account-isolated cache, transactional list batches, bulk metadata reads, safe upserts and selected-feed query
Data/Store.swift: Foreground sync preserves loaded rows; incremental paging adjusts for confirmed state writes; cloud journal, cache, bodies and preferences; reader-session-scoped body loading and isolated slow-fulltext UI fixture
Views/RootView.swift: Measured overlay tab bar with content clearance; double tap scrolls to top and hides read article rows; cloud connection/navigation
Views/ArticleListScreen.swift: 900pt prefetch independent of auto-read, inline retry, top-scroll command, stable tab clearance and independent article cells; locally measured top-header spacer without duplicate List margins or minimum row heights or cross-view preference propagation; preserve top alignment after measured search-header cell relayout without moving an existing reading position; dismiss the search keyboard when opening an article
Support/Format.swift: Reuse date formatters and parsed cloud timestamps instead of creating them per row
Models/AppSettings.swift: Persist card or plain article list style; older settings retain card appearance
Views/Components.swift: PWA density, title, summary, thumbnail, metadata and feed colors; card or plain rows reused by settings preview
Views/DesignComponents.swift: Each choice has its own stable accessibility identifier instead of inheriting a shared group identifier
Views/CachedArticleImage.swift: Decode device-direct thumbnails at density-specific display size
Views/FeedsView.swift: Bottom tab clearance and double-tap scroll to top; host app actions in existing overflow menu
Views/ReaderView.swift: Native article-tools sheet; hide unsupported force-fetch in cloud mode; continuous read/extract/render status above content, reduced-motion-aware transitions and explicit render retry
Views/ReaderWebView.swift: Generation-scoped visible-document loading callbacks; wait for initial layout before restoring position and crossfading; retain last snapshot on failure and reject stale completions
Views/SettingsView.swift: Shared real-row preview, PWA density explanation, explicit hide-read action, bottom clearance and tab scroll to top
